lines.zh: 我每一步都压得地面下陷。
lines.en: Every step of mine sinks the ground.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住整片赤土。
lines.en: My shadow covers the red earth.
Red sand falls off me as I go.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但没人能挡。
lines.en: I don't walk fast, but nothing stops me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，赤土陷下去。
lines.en: The red earth sinks wherever I tread.

lines.zh: 我绕过一座风化的石柱。
lines.en: I pass a weathered pillar.

lines.zh: 赤土谷里没有别的声音。
lines.en: Nothing else sounds in the badlands.
My footprints are deep enough to hold water.

lines.zh: 我朝着召唤我的地方走。
lines.en: I walk toward where I was called.

lines.zh: 尘在我身后成了一条线。
lines.en: Dust trails in a line behind me.

lines.zh: 赤土的热气贴在我胸口。
lines.en: The heat of the red earth clings to my chest.
The badlands wind can't move me.
I'm waiting for the next core.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸带起一阵热风。
lines.en: My breath stirs a hot wind.

lines.zh: 我的掌纹里嵌着碎石子。
lines.en: Bits of gravel are lodged in the lines of my palm.
The pillar's shadow has moved.
I don't sit down.
The sun can't hurt me.
I'm measuring this valley.
The ground cracks faintly under me.
I raise my head to pillar height.

lines.zh: 赤红的尘在我肩上落了一层。
lines.en: Red dust settles on my shoulders.
I listen to footsteps far off.
I've waited a long while.

lines.zh: 石柱的影子还没转过半圈。
lines.en: The pillar's shadow has not swung half around.
It's empty around here today.

lines.zh: 你拿着一块核心，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the core in your hand.

lines.zh: 一个金苹果就够把我叫来。
lines.en: One golden apple is enough to call me.
You have some nerve.
You're standing in the middle of my shadow.

lines.zh: 你站直了，也只到我膝盖。
lines.en: Standing tall, you still only reach my knee.
I'm not just passing through.
Step back and I might leave.

lines.zh: 我记得是谁把我叫出来的。
lines.en: I remember who called me.

lines.zh: 你那层铁，挡不住一块赤土。
lines.en: That iron will not stop a lump of red earth.
I lift a foot and set it back down.
Will you fight, or run?
The red earth will remember this.
I step back half; the ground splits.

lines.zh: 打在我身上，像打在石头上。
lines.en: It lands on me like on stone.
I shrug, and clods of earth roll off.
My arm moves slower now.
My chest plate knocks.
I didn't make a sound.

lines.zh: 赤土吸收了我的一点血。
lines.en: The red earth drinks a little of my blood.
I reset my stance.
That one made me sway half an inch.
This little sting only makes me angrier.
I know the smell of a golden apple.
Calling me again?
Hold it closer; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我就是被这东西叫出来的。
lines.en: That's what brought me here.
Say what you want.
I lean down, a little closer.
That isn't for me.
I smell gold.
Raise it once more and I'll move.

lines.zh: 金苹果的香味，把我叫醒。
lines.en: The smell of the golden apple wakes me.

lines.zh: 你的身子撞上我的小腿。
lines.en: Your body hits my shin.
You bounce three steps back on your own.
You're bounced back a few paces.
The ground cracks between us.
You bounced away from my foot.
I didn't shift a step.
A sheet of red dust lifts.
You hit me like running into a cliff.
Clinging to my ankle will not save you.
I shift my foot and leave you a gap.
I'm the only one in this valley.

lines.zh: 我被做出来，不是生出来的。
lines.en: I was made, not born.
No kin, only cores.

lines.zh: 我数过这片谷，只有我一个。
lines.en: I've counted this valley; I'm alone.

lines.zh: 我坐在这儿，什么也没有。
lines.en: I sit here with nothing.
So quiet I can hear sand fall.

lines.zh: 我被唤醒，不是为了繁衍。
lines.en: I was woken for something other than breeding.
I raise a hand, then pull it back.

lines.zh: 有些东西，是被造出来的。
lines.en: Some things are simply made.
I'm still standing.
One clench of my fingers and it crumbles.
That one on the ground is yours.
If I bend, the ground gives.
I brush it aside with my hand.
That's too light for me to feel.
I picked up one stone.
It crumbles when I close my fist.
I dropped it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我一脚就踩碎。
lines.en: One step and whatever lies there is crushed.
Keep it yourself.
I take the first step.
My chest brightens once.
The badlands split beneath me.

lines.zh: 红沙一动，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: When the red sand stirs, I know where you are.
I lift my right foot.

lines.zh: 这一片谷都是我的地方。
lines.en: This whole valley is mine.

lines.zh: 我迈出一步，沙丘就低了。
lines.en: One step of mine and the dune sinks.
You actually stayed.
You've some nerve.
Dust covers half the sky.
My breathing grows heavy.

lines.zh: 刚才那声，是我落下的脚。
lines.en: That thud just now was my foot coming down.
That was my step.
I bend half my height.

lines.zh: 第二块核心都不管用了。
lines.en: Not even a second core would help you.
I cross the whole gully in one step.
The cracks spread.

lines.zh: 这片赤土会吞掉你的脚印。
lines.en: This red earth will swallow your footprints.

lines.zh: 我的手臂挡住了半边天。
lines.en: My arm blots out half the sky.
Only this one foot.
I follow in long strides.
You're faster than you look.

lines.zh: 我慢，可这片谷没有出口。
lines.en: I am slow, but this valley has no way out.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在我脚下很小。
lines.en: Your prints are tiny under mine.
One step of mine covers three of your breaths.
Pillars fall at my touch.
You go behind a pillar.
I pushed it down.
This valley has no exit.
Every ten steps you take, I take one.

lines.zh: 你越跑，扬起的红沙越多。
lines.en: The more you run, the more red dust you kick up.
Dust has covered the path.
The sun no longer reaches you from above.
You look up at me.
I wait for you to strike.
You reach the valley mouth; I have not stopped.

lines.zh: 我把全身的重量压在这一拳上。
lines.en: I put my whole weight behind this fist.
The ground you stand on is splitting.
My shadow falls on you first.
And bring it down.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地面凹陷。
lines.en: My fist comes down; the ground dents.
Red earth flies high.
You're thrown far back.
My foot splits the stone.
You blocked it, and slid five paces.
One palm of mine can flatten a slope.
The plate caves in and pops off.
Your plate is dented.
I didn't stop.
The ground shakes in a ring.

lines.zh: 这一脚下去，你还剩几口气？
lines.en: After this stomp, how much breath will you have left?
I breathe out hot air.

lines.zh: 尘土把我们两个都罩住。
lines.en: Dust covers us both.
I move my foot forward.
A crack opens in the middle of the badlands.

lines.zh: 你把金苹果按在了核心上。
lines.en: You pressed the golden apple to the core.
I rise from below the ground.
Red sand settles on my shoulders.
The whole valley shakes once.
I stand, taller than the pillars.
My breath pushes the dust aside.

lines.zh: 整片恶地都空了，只剩我。
lines.en: The whole badlands is empty but for me.
The core glows, waiting for me to step.
The cracks on the surface keep spreading.
I raise my head to the sun.
My shadow fills the valley floor.
I hear my own joints crack.
The red earth tastes dry.

lines.zh: 赤土从肩上滑下去，我醒了。
lines.en: Red earth slides from my shoulders; I am awake.
Nothing can block me.
Each step lowers the ground.
I'm here; don't run too far.
In this valley, I am the largest.
I halt at the valley mouth.

lines.zh: 火在我皮肤上烧，像在干土上。
lines.en: Fire burns on me like on dry clay.

lines.zh: 这一摔，把我自己砸进了土里。
lines.en: I fell so hard I drove myself into the ground.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的动作变慢。
lines.en: Water gets in; my movement slows.
The blast opens against my chest.
Several points stick in my shoulder.
The light presses on my frame.
Empty a long while, my strength ebbs.

lines.zh: 雷击在我身上，赤土都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; the red earth glows.
Not even red earth here.
